posts.alt: Del Mar coastal-contemporary backyard with a rectangular pool, raised glass-tile spa, large-format porcelain paver deck and soft ocean light
posts.hook: Design the yard around the water and everything else falls into place.
posts.caption:
Design a backyard around the water and everything else finds its place — the deck, the spa, the sightlines all take their cue from that one clean rectangle.

Large-format porcelain runs right to the coping, a raised spa spills quietly into the pool, and the coastal light does the rest.

The selections:
• rectangular pool with raised spa
• glass-tile spa waterline
• Belgard Porcelain deck
• flush-mount coping
• coastal drought-tolerant planting

posts.style: Craft & Process · The Detail That Lasts
posts.alt: Close-up of a Warming Trends CrossFire brass burner set in a natural-stone fire feature with a tall, even flame
posts.hook: The part you never see is the part that lasts.
posts.caption:
Most fire features fail at the burner. We spec the brass one on purpose.

A Warming Trends CrossFire pulls in air as it burns, so you get a taller, fuller flame on less gas — and brass won't corrode the way the cheaper steel kits do. It's the kind of decision you only notice years later, when yours still lights on the first try.

The selections:
• Warming Trends CrossFire burner
• solid brass construction
• natural-stone surround
• lava-rock media
• concealed electronic ignition

Want it built to last at every layer? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Aerial view of a Poway backyard putting green in synthetic turf ringed by paver paths and drought-tolerant planting
posts.hook: Poway lots are big enough to build your own short game.
posts.caption:
The inland lots out in Poway give you room most coastal yards don't — enough to fold a real putting green into the design without crowding everything else out.

Seen from above you can read the whole thing: contoured turf, cups set at different breaks, paver paths tying it back to the patio. Practice in the morning, entertain at night.

The selections:
• SYNLawn Golf putting green
• multiple cups & breaks
• Belgard paver paths
• drought-tolerant borders
• low-voltage path lighting

Want a putting green worked into your yard? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.style: Lifestyle · The Evening It's Built For
posts.alt: Bonita backyard at dusk with a round fire pit, built-in seat wall, artificial turf and warm string lights overhead
posts.hook: The best room in the house doesn't have a roof.
posts.caption:
There's a stretch right after dinner — string lights on, fire lit, kids still running on the turf — when the backyard quietly becomes the best room in the house.

That's the whole point. Not a yard you look at. A room you live in, built for the ordinary Tuesday as much as the party.

The selections:
• round fire pit with seat wall
• SYNLawn play turf
• Belgard Urbana pavers
• café string lighting
• olive & citrus planting

Want the room you actually live in? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Santaluz estate outdoor living room with an Eldorado Stone fireplace, deep linen seating and a Techo-Bloc patio at golden hour
posts.hook: We come back ten months later. On purpose.
posts.caption:
Most crews are gone the day they cash the check. We put a date on the calendar for ten months out — and come back.

By then the space has lived through a full range of seasons, which is exactly when small things show themselves and exactly when we want to catch them. We walk the whole yard with you, fine-toothed, and make it right. Part of every project, never an upsell.

The selections:
• Eldorado Stone fireplace
• Techo-Bloc patio
• deep linen seating
• built-in wood storage
• FX Luminaire lighting

Want a builder who comes back? DM “DESIGN”.
